shape: the CAESAR 6x6 at 0.8 scale: forward armoured cab with crew compartment (raked framed windscreen, side windows, four doors, grille, guarded lamps, roof hatch, whips, beacon), ladder frame on three axles with leaf springs and lugged tyres under wings, fuel and air tanks, exhaust; the long gun platform with ammunition lockers and hinged lids, the travel-lock A-frame behind the cab carrying the barrel, jerrycans, tarp, cleaning staff; at the rear the gun mount with trunnion cheeks, elevating arcs, equilibrators, cradle, recoil cylinders, breech, loading tray, rammer, layer's sight and seat, the 52-calibre barrel with bore evacuator and double-baffle brake lying forward over the cab; rear jacks and the firing spade on its arms and rams.
confidence: xấp xỉ (CAESAR photographs and drawings; the fix L8 layout kept)
